summary: Retest of the iOS placeholder 'Try again' button: FAILED. The fix described in the review request is not in the code. /app/ios-app/www/index.html (mtime Nov 9 02:04) and ios/App/App/public/index.html are identical and still set retry.style.display = "" in the setTimeout and spin.style.display = "" in go(). No file in the repo contains 'inline-block'. /app/frontend/public/ios-placeholder-test.html does not exist, so the preview URL serves the React SPA. I served the current www/index.html on a stub origin with navigation stubbed and trademainhub.com aborted, at 390x844. After 6.8s: #spin display none (OK), message 'Hub Trade didn't load. Check your connection and try again.' (OK), #retry computed display none (FAIL). The button cannot be seen, so the click/retry step could not be tested.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Try again' button stays hidden after the 6s fallback. The code still uses style.display = '', so the CSS rule #retry{display:none} wins. The claimed fix was not saved to disk.
The 6s timer is still armed only once at load and not again in go(). spin.style.display='' works only because .spin has no display:none rule.

action_items: Edit /app/ios-app/www/index.html: in the setTimeout, set document.getElementById('retry').style.display = 'inline-block'. In go(), set spin to 'block' and restart the timer (clearTimeout plus a new setTimeout inside go()).
Copy the file to /app/ios-app/ios/App/App/public/index.html (or run npx cap sync ios).
If an in-browser retest is wanted, also copy it to /app/frontend/public/ios-placeholder-test.html. It does not exist right now.
Check the edit with grep before asking for a retest (grep inline-block /app/ios-app/www/index.html).
critical_code_review_comments: The change was claimed but never written to disk. No 'inline-block' anywhere in the repo.
Toggling a CSS class (for example .show) would be more robust than inline styles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test method: read /app/ios-app/www/index.html, replace 'window.location.replace(APP_URL);' with a stub counter, serve it via page.context.route on https://stub.local and abort trademainhub.com. Wait 6.8s and check getComputedStyle display of #spin and #retry.
rca of the issue: The cause is the same as in iteration_13 and is not fixed: element.style.display='' removes the inline style, so the stylesheet's #retry{display:none} applies again. The file on disk was never updated.
